answer.text:

Calculation: \((15{,}864 - 14{,}216) / 14{,}216 \times 100 \approx 11.6\%\), reported as **12%**.

Source: Adobe Inc. 10-K, accession **0000796343-25-000004**, “Segments,” chunk **839ad4e2-d434-562b-b699-c27185c0972b**.
